title: Rebase a branch
setup: git init -q . && git symbolic-ref HEAD refs/heads/main
printf 'base\n' > base.txt && git add base.txt && git commit -qm 'Add base'
git checkout -q -b feature && printf 'one\n' > f1.txt && git add f1.txt && git commit -qm 'Add f1' && printf 'two\n' > f2.txt && git add f2.txt && git commit -qm 'Add f2'
git checkout -q main && printf 'main work\n' > m1.txt && git add m1.txt && git commit -qm 'Add m1'

checks.name: feature now sits on top of main
feature has no merge commits (history is a straight line)
feature contains m1.txt, f1.txt and f2.txt
checks.cmd: git cat-file -e feature:m1.txt && git cat-file -e feature:f1.txt && git cat-file -e feature:f2.txt

hints: Be on the branch that should move: git switch feature
Then name what it should sit on: git rebase main
